item.summary: The Union Cabinet chaired by the Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi today has approved the Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) rates for RABI Season, 2026-27 (from 01.10.2026 to 31.03.2027) on Phosphatic and Potassic (P&K) fertilizers. The tentative budgetary requirement for Rabi 2026-27 would be approximately Rs.62,370.02 crore. This is approximate Rs.24,417.73 crore more than the budgetary…
item.title: Cabinet approves Nutrient Based Subsidy (NBS) rates for Rabi 2026-27 (from 01.10.2026 to 31.03.2027) on Phosphatic and Potassic (P&K) fertilizers
